title: HELIX Bridge: Banner → AcademicOrg
saas_vs_onprem: Banner SaaS (Ellucian Cloud) uses the same underlying Oracle schema. Access methods differ: on-prem uses direct Oracle SQL; SaaS uses Ellucian Data Connect (EDC), Ethos Integration API, or Banner Integration API (BIA). Table/column names are identical across both deployment models.

source_tables.description: College validation. College codes and descriptions.
Department validation. Department codes and descriptions.
Finance organization. Organizational hierarchy for financial reporting. Often mirrors academic org structure.

attribute_mappings.transformation: Direct map. Colleges and departments are separate validation tables in Banner.
STVCOLL entries → 'college'. STVDEPT entries → 'department'. Banner doesn't have a single org hierarchy table like PeopleSoft — college and department are separate concepts.

attribute_mappings.source: STVDEPT → implicit college relationship via SCBCRSE/SSBSECT dept-to-college linkage
attribute_mappings.transformation: Banner doesn't store explicit dept→college hierarchy. Derived from course/section data (which college a department's courses belong to) or from FTVORGN finance hierarchy.

notes: Banner's academic organizational structure is flatter than PeopleSoft's tree-based model. Colleges (STVCOLL) and departments (STVDEPT) are independent validation tables without an explicit parent-child relationship. The linkage is implied through course ownership (SCBCRSE.SCBCRSE_COLL_CODE) and section assignment (SSBSECT). FTVORGN provides a finance-side org hierarchy that often parallels the academic structure but may not match exactly.
